name: v2.2.8
body:
## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* feat: support JavaScript URL entries with factory type probes by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15666
* feat: resolver cache in the new cache system by @ahabhgk in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15839
### Performance 🚀
* perf(core): box optional match resource data by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15831
* perf: reduce exports info and parser memory footprint by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15821
* perf(core): box optional RSC metadata by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15837
* perf(concatenated): store binding references as indices by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15834
* perf: reuse compilation dependency arrays and strings by @SyMind in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15763
* perf(core): box import attributes by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15844
* perf(core): shrink dependency location storage by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15849
* perf(core): store module requests as boxed strings by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15856
* perf: reduce retained dependency and source capacity by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15854
* perf(javascript): share the used-by-exports payload of a dependency by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15851
* perf: skip unused code splitting cache copies by @JSerFeng in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15867
* perf(stats): release handles per module while converting stats to JS by @stormslowly in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15788
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* fix(types): allow void context module waterfall callbacks by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15832
* fix: revert "feat: support JavaScript URL entries with factory type probes" by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15840
* fix: preserve deferred evaluation in modern-module output by @JSerFeng in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15846
* fix(resolve): resolve relative tsconfig paths against cwd by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15713
* fix(rstest): resolve mock APIs through the runtime registry by @9aoy in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15823
* fix: interrupt compaction at cache shutdown by @ahabhgk in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15850
* fix(types): make SharePlugin enhanced option optional by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15855
* fix(types): align externals function signatures by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15857
* fix(types): correct externals resolver overloads by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15863
* fix: reset MultiCompiler done state on watch restart by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15865
* fix(types): allow unnamed module federation consumers by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15868
* fix: require a name for shared dependency tree shaking by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15872
* fix(types): allow stats printer hooks to return void by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15874
* fix(types): support custom stats fields in extract hooks by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15880
* fix(types): allow shouldEmit hooks to return void by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15881
* fix(types): allow Node fs as intermediate file system by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15895
* fix(types): accept entry dependencies in ModuleGraph queries by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15896
* fix(cli): enable compile cache before loading CLI by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15903
* fix: respect CI=false and skip compile cache in CI by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15904
* fix(rstest): transform non-hoisted mock APIs in expression position by @fi3ework in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15877
* fix: avoid retaining source copies in RealContentHash by @JSerFeng in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15902
* fix(loader): avoid mutating lightningcss-loader options by @tiagovilasboas in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15900
* fix(loader): normalize builtin options for inline requests by @SoonIter in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15909
### Document 📖
* docs: clarify externals usage and consolidate function reference by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15866
### Other Changes
* chore(deps): upgrade Rstack to 0.8.0 by @SoonIter in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15838
* chore(test): migrate 60 more configs to TypeScript by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15836
* test: migrate 47 more configs to TypeScript by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15843
* chore(test): migrate 20 cache and callback configs to TypeScript by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15852
* chore(deps): update dependency memfs to v4.79.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15891
* chore(deps): update rust crate swc_ecma_minifier to 61.0.9 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15890
* chore(deps): update patch npm dependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15889
* chore(deps): update dependency webpack-sources to v3.5.3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15888
* test: migrate HTTP integrity configuration to TypeScript by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15892
* test: migrate five configurations to TypeScript by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15893

## New Contributors
* @tiagovilasboas made their first contribution in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15900

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/compare/v2.2.7...v2.2.8
